description: This file defines the 'PooledBuffer' struct, an implementation of IBufferWriter<byte> using pooled arrays to create ReadOnlySequence<byte> instances. It manages memory segments, supports writing, copying, slicing, and enumeration over the buffer's data, and uses a custom pool for memory segments.

classes.name: SequenceSegmentPool
classes.description: A singleton class managing pools of sequence segments, providing methods to rent and return segments, optimizing memory reuse.

classes.name: SequenceSegment
classes.description: A custom linked-list segment class inheriting from ReadOnlySequenceSegment<byte>, representing chunks of pooled byte arrays, with methods for initialization, resizing, and validation.

methods.name: ToArray
methods.description: Converts the written data in the buffer into a byte array.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the write position by a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the buffer, clearing all memory segments and state.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Releases resources by resetting the buffer.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Provides a Memory<byte> with at least the requested size hint.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Provides a Span<byte> with at least the requested size hint.

methods.name: Write (ReadOnlySequence<byte>)
methods.description: Writes data from a ReadOnlySequence<byte> into this buffer.

methods.name: Write (ReadOnlySpan<byte>)
methods.description: Writes data from a ReadOnlySpan<byte> into this buffer.

methods.name: Grow
methods.description: Allocates a new sequence segment of at least the specified size and sets it as the write head.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Commits the current write by linking the write head into the segment chain and updating total length.
